ranked_evidence.title: PM Modi breaks silence on NEET-UG
ranked_evidence.snippet: Vol.19 Issue 198 PIONEER NEWS SERVICE n New Delhi Amidst massive public outrage on NEET-UG paper leak, Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Tuesday broke his silence over the issue and asserted that strong action has been taken against those involved in paper leaks so that no one plays with the future of the youth, while terming the leaks ghor paap (grave sin). PM Modi said all State Governments and the Union Government must join hands on the issue as it is “not a matter of party politics but a matter of national interest”. Sources said PM Modi also told NDA leaders that there is a need to “win the trust of the youth” while suggesting a national outreach by MPs among students on the issue. PIONEER NEWS SERVICE n New Delhi The Delhi Police on Tuesday forcibly removed and detained Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra as well as SP chief Akhilesh Yadav from outside Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s residence for protesting against the police action on students on Monday and demanding the PM’s resignation.
